basics.name: Diego E. Salazar
basics.label: Senior/Staff Software Engineer · AI & LLM product engineering · Full-stack + data platforms · Former VP of Engineering
basics.tagline: I build AI-powered products and the platforms underneath them.
summary: I build AI-powered products and the platforms underneath them, from hand-written HTML/CSS and React UIs to the infrastructure, data pipelines and databases behind them. I've been writing software for 20 years, both as a hands-on senior/staff engineer and as a VP of Engineering.

Recent work: At Sony Music, designing full-stack systems on AWS (React SPAs, ECS/Lambda, Aurora, Terraform, Jenkins) and re-architecting a sales-matching system to scale from gigabytes to terabytes. At Bloomberg Law, lead engineer on AI-powered legal document analysis, shipping GPT/LLM features in standalone apps and Microsoft Word add-ins on serverless AWS backends. At Kipu Health, VP of Engineering at a healthcare SaaS company, growing the team from 3 to 20 engineers and setting the architecture, policies and remote practices it scaled on.

I also build my own AI tooling, like AiSyncing, an open-source tool that backs up AI assistants' memories and configs every day. I'm at my best owning ambiguous problems end to end: untangling coupled systems, choosing a pragmatic architecture, and making the team around me faster. I've mentored interns and bootcamp students along the way, and I'm fluent in English and Spanish.

work.name: Sony Music Entertainment
work.summary: Senior engineer on Sony Music's PDE engineering team, designing and owning full-stack systems on AWS, from SPA frontends to the database layer.
highlights: Re-architected the sales-matching system to scale from gigabyte- to terabyte-scale data volumes.
Designed and architected full-stack systems spanning React SPA frontends, ECS- and Lambda-based backends, and Aurora MySQL/MariaDB databases.
Defined all infrastructure in Terraform, deployed through strict Jenkins pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows.
Identified and broke apart tightly coupled systems, simplifying the architecture and speeding up developer workflows.
work.stack: TypeScript, Python (typed, mypy), React, Bash, HTML/CSS, AWS (ECS, Lambda, Aurora MySQL/MariaDB), Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

work.name: Bloomberg Law
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on Bloomberg Law's Web Products team, then lead engineer on a new product team building AI-powered legal document analysis, owning architecture, UI/UX and APIs.
highlights: Built GPT/LLM-powered document analysis features, shipping rich, responsive UIs in standalone apps and inside Microsoft products.
Built Microsoft Word add-ins with Office.js, bringing document analysis into lawyers' existing workflow.
Led architecture and implementation of serverless backends on AWS API Gateway and Lambda, with React and Vue SPAs on CloudFront and S3.
Lead engineer for infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK) and CI/CD on GitHub and GitLab; decoupled frontend and backend releases with CDN-based SPA deploys.
Planned and led the migration from Rails-rendered pages to a Vue SPA backed by a JSON API.
Mentored interns and onboarded them to the Bloomberg Law stack; interviewer on the Diversity & Inclusion recruiting team.
work.stack: TypeScript, React, Vue, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Java, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS
